name: seltz
tagline_zh: 写代码时查资料总怕过时？Seltz 直接搜官方源，带日期和出处，不翻墙不切窗口，答案像代码注释一样干净。
tagline_en: Tired of stale web answers while coding? Seltz pulls current, source-backed facts with dates—no tab-hopping, no.
desc_en: Use Seltz's official MCP search tool for current, source-backed web research in Codex.
why_zh: 同类工具只给链接，它把来源和时效直接嵌进回答，省去二次核验，像给搜索装了证据链。
why_en: Unlike link-dump tools, it embeds source and timeliness into each answer, cutting verification steps—search with a built-in.
